wrote /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/uv/suite_in_chunks.sh: #!/bin/bash
# Runs the codegen suite one MODULE at a time, reclaiming scratch space between chunks.
#
# A single whole-suite run needs more transient disk than this volume has: the harness deletes a
# test's scratch directory on SUCCESS only, so once failures start they leave ~2 MB each, which
# fills the disk, which causes more failures. That is what turned one run into 2 443 failures whose
# tests all pass individually.
#
# Chunking bounds the in-flight footprint and gives a verdict per module instead of one number that
# a single environmental problem can invalidate. Full output per chunk g
